name: Purdue University
academic_ranking: Purdue is a major public research university (member of the Association of American Universities). U.S. News & World Report (2026 edition) ranks it approximately 46th among national universities and 19th among public universities, and it is highly regarded for STEM/engineering (top-10 engineering school, ranked among the most innovative national universities). Admissions are classified as 'more selective' (roughly 49% acceptance rate).
financial_aid: Public university with in-state (Indiana resident) tuition and fees of approximately $9,992/yr and non-resident tuition of approximately $28,794/yr (NCES published rate, 2024-25). Purdue is nationally known for its long-running tuition freeze holding rates flat for over a decade. Athletic scholarships plus need- and merit-based institutional aid, federal aid, and state grants are available. Verify current figures with Purdue's Office of the Bursar and Division of Financial Aid.
facilities_notes: Softball competes at Bittinger Stadium on the West Lafayette campus.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I women's softball program competing in the Big Ten Conference. Part of Purdue's Big Ten athletics department in West Lafayette, IN.
notes: Coaching staff and roster captured live from purduesports.com staff directory and softball roster page on 2026-07 (roster page reflected the 2027 season, 24 players). The direct softball coaches URL (/sports/softball/coaches) returned 404; softball staff were captured from the athletics staff directory (/staff-directory) filtered to the Softball department. No phone numbers or Twitter/X handles are publicly listed for softball staff. Tuition figures sourced from NCES College Navigator (published 2024-25 rates) because Purdue's bursar pages did not expose dollar amounts to automated retrieval.
